name: 5x5 Custom Canopy Tent – Steel Frame with Full Back Wall & Two Half Side Walls (Logo Printing)
descriptionHtml:
Premium 5'x 5' Custom Canopy Tent

  • Heavy-duty steel frame + wheeled carry bag
  • 1 Full Wall Single Side Fully Printed With Unlimited Colors & Graphics
  • 2 Half Side Walls Single Side Fully Printed With Unlimited Colors & Graphics
  • Dye-sublimation printed 600D Oxford fabric
  • Waterproof, Fire Resistant, UV Protection
  • Free Ground Shipping (FedEx) Nationwide

Features:                                                                                      

  • Canopy is constructed of durable, weather-resistant 600 denier polyester
  • Your artwork will be dye sublimated on a white canopy
  • Crank-up canopy creates a taut, clean peak
  • Frame is constructed of Steel
  • Frame features ABS glass-filled nylon joints
  • Square-shaped legs are 1.75" in diameter
  • Legs feature plastic levers for pinch-free height adjustment
  • Easily collapses to fit inside the included soft case with wheels
  • The tent can be secured to the ground with the included stake kit
  • Frame must be secured to the ground to prevent wind damage (failure to secure the tent voids the warranty)
  • Imprint Method: Full-Color Dye Sublimation

Product Dimensions

  • Product Size: 60" W x 137" H x 60" D
  • Collapsible Dimensions: 9.12" W x 62.75" H x 9.12" D
  • Case Dimensions: 12.5" W x 56.25" H x 15.5" D
  • Product Weight: Frame + Wheel Bag Weight: 30lbs
  • Full Wall: 58"w x 79"h 

Kit Includes

  • 1: Hardware (Frame)
  • 1: Canopy
  • 1: Full Wall
  • 2: Half Walls
  • 1: Wheeled Carry Bag
  • 1: Ropes and Pegs Set

Optional Accessories:

  • 6' Table Cover
  • Feather Flags
  • Sandbags

Materials

  • Hardware: ABS Nylon, Steel
  • Canopy: 600 Denier Polyester

Certifications

  • Meets FR Rating Requirements
  • Primary Usage
  • Outdoor

Warranty

  • 1-year canopy and soft case warranty - Standard warranty is a parts and labor warranty, which warrants the product against defects in material and workmanship. It does not cover damage due to accidents, abuse, or normal wear and tear. Products found to be defective will be replaced or repaired at the factory's discretion.
  • Lifetime hardware warranty - Standard warranty is a parts and labor warranty, which warrants the product against defects in material and workmanship. It does not cover damage due to accidents, abuse, or normal wear and tear. Products found to be defective will be replaced or repaired at the factory's discretion

howToOrderHtml:
3 Easy Steps

Step 1: Shop 🛒

Pick your products and add-ons, then add your order to the cart.

Step 2: Payment 💳

Go to your cart and choose your payment option:

Full payment: your design gets priority 🚀

Deposit: start the design now and pay the remaining balance after artwork approval

(Deposit option applies only to orders over $295 USD. Orders below this amount require full payment.)

Step 3: Artwork 🎨

Complete checkout and upload your artwork using the provided link.

Don’t see it? No worries — we’ll email it to you.
